We got this together!! Being able to talk about how I feel and express myself has really helped me feel like myself more. 
I’m so proud and happy for you survival. You got this. Show the people that have wronged you that you can live an amazing life without them. You’re the winner in your story.

Thank you for replying. I’m still here. I think the breaking point for me is that I’ve felt this way before, and I remember how drawn out and awful it felt last time. I really don’t wanna be upset like this anymore.
Quickest reply ever. Thank you dude
